notes: Customer opening balances (debit and credit menu entries, AR types with TRNS_TYPE 6): header checks, line checks and derivations, generated customer transaction (AR_MAINTRNS / AR_SUBTRNS) and customer balance fields per line, delete / change rules (APP_RULES3_AR).

rules.where: TRNS_ID in (select ID from AR_TRNSTYPE where TRNS_TYPE = 6) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or TRNS_ID in (select TRNS_ID from AR_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD where FLAG = 1 and PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

row_rules.AR_MAINTRNS_OP: if app_rules3_ar.is_form('ARTRN_OP') then app_rules3_ar.op_mast_row(inserting, :new.trns_id, :new.trns_serial, :new.trns_date, :new.doc_no, :new.description_a, :new.description_e, :old.trns_id, :old.trns_serial); end if;
row_rules.AR_SUBTRNS_OP: if app_rules3_ar.is_form('ARTRN_OP') then app_rules3_ar.op_line_row(inserting, :new.trns_id, :new.trns_serial, :new.customer_id, :new.ctgry_code, :new.mainarea_id, :new.subarea_id, :new.salesman_id, :new.currency_code, :new.currency_rate, :new.total_value, :new.bill_id1, :new.bill_id2, :new.r_trns_serial, :old.customer_id, :old.ctgry_code, :old.salesman_id, :old.total_value, :old.r_trns_serial); end if;

info.name: TOT
info.sql: select to_char(sum(total_value), 'FM999G999G999G990D00') from ar_subtrns_op where trns_id = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_ID) and trns_serial = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL)

info.name: TOTR
info.sql: select to_char(sum(total_value * nvl(currency_rate, 1)), 'FM999G999G999G990D00') from ar_subtrns_op where trns_id = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_ID) and trns_serial = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL)

info.name: EFF
info.sql: select max(case effect when 0 then app_rules3_ar.msg('مدين', 'Debit') when 1 then app_rules3_ar.msg('دائن', 'Credit') end) from ar_trnstype where id = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_ID)
